result.question: 2022-yil 3-yanvardagi «Портландцемент ЦЕМ I 42,5 Н» bitimlarida hajm bo‘yicha o‘rtacha tortilgan bir tonna narxi so‘mda qancha? Barcha holatlarni kiriting.
result.text:
2022-yil 3-yanvarda **«Портландцемент ЦЕМ I 42,5 Н»** bitimlarining barcha holatlar bo‘yicha hajmga tortilgan o‘rtacha narxi **754 502,53 so‘m/tonna** bo‘lgan.

evidence.sql: SELECT currency, unit, count(*) AS deals, round(sum(amount)/nullif(sum(volume),0),2) AS weighted_all, round(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)')/nullif(sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'),0),2) AS weighted_not_cancelled, round(avg(unit_price),2) AS simple_all FROM v_deals WHERE product_name = 'Портландцемент ЦЕМ I 42,5 Н' AND deal_date >= DATE '2022-01-03' AND deal_date < DATE '2022-01-04' GROUP BY currency,unit
